lines.english: "Hey, look…"
"Hm? What～?"
"There, on the other side of the road. At the university's main gate. Isn't that girl wearing our school uniform…?"
"You mean her…? I believe that's a third-year student's… ahh!"
"I know, right? It really is her, right? Thank goodness I didn't mistake her for someone else."
"So the rumors about her getting involved with a guy from our university were true…"
"Man, you really saved me! It's really hard to find some organized notes for linguistics."
"…You should really stop resorting to borrowing notes from students in other departments."
The call I received around the time before the date changed last night had an unusually friendly request of "Bring your French notes with you tomorrow, Haruki!"
"It's your fault for suddenly deciding to change departments. Have you ever seriously considered just how badly my grades would be affected by your decision?"
"…You should seriously consider passing your exams with your own efforts first."
…I pressed the answer button without looking at the caller and froze for a few seconds, but that's another story.
"Well, then… what do you plan to do for the rest of the day?"
"I'll be studying from the moment I get home, obviously."
"…What an exemplary and boring answer. I see you still can't really be called a university student, as always."
"…This is coming from someone who just wasted quite a lot of my unnecessary time."
There was a long line at the photocopier we went to after the exam ended, and I let out a big sigh knowing that it wasn't worth waiting for my turn.
"…If you're saying your time is unnecessary, then what's wrong with me wasting it? What are you talking about?"
"Huh!? Hey, don't misinterpret my grammar on purpose! You're making it seem as if I've spoken in a rather confusing way here!"
"No, your statement actually was confusing. …Though I do plan to treat you to dinner as a token of my apology and gratitude."
"Then I'll correct myself and say that you've wasted my 'precious time.' …You can invite me out after my exams are over."
"Today should be fine given that we're free on Saturday, right? Want to drink a little?"
"Actually, my real hurdle starts next week. I still have nine subjects left after all, and three of them are on Monday."
"…You've already collected enough credits to graduate, right? You're just doing the rest out of pure interest."
"Whatever. In any case, I'll be studying from now until Monday morning. I don't think I'll be able to forgive myself in more ways than one otherwise."

…This is particularly related to a certain someone who frantically and desperately tried to remain cheerful, despite the fact that her tone immediately dropped the moment she realized I wasn't coming to work on the weekend…
…That's right. Perhaps I could study at Goodies this weekend? And then we could take a short, leisurely walk on our way home before getting on the train?
She'd lecture me with "the restaurant isn't a place for studying" and happily reprimand me if I'd made that suggestion, wouldn't she?
"A week left, huh… Can't it end any sooner?"
"…You can say that again."
Now that I think about it, the reason why "Sugiura Koharu" didn't appear on my phone's display around the usual time she'd call last night is because I was busy with another call.
I wonder if it's because she got tired of waiting and fell asleep or if she's fed up with calling me every night…
Or perhaps something exciting happened at school, such that she didn't need to hear my voice anymore…
Well, whatever the reason, it's fine. So long as it's not the opposite of what I just thought, anything would be…
"That's right… will you be going to Setsuna-chan's party next week?"
"…She invited you too?"
"Are you suggesting you'd prefer to be alone with her?"
"What are you talking about…? The occasion was intended to be celebrated with her family to begin with."
"I just thought that you wanted to tell them something like, 'Please entrust your daughter to me!'"
"Don't suggest something so… ridiculous."
I'm feeling slightly giddy over the fact that what I was thinking about a short moment ago really isn't matching the conversation I'm having with Takeya.

"Io and I will be making ourselves welcome as well. After all, this is Setsuna-chan's homemade cooking we're talking about here, right? …Though I guess you can say that this is a birthday party where the birthday girl herself will be making the cake."
"I… see…"
"Make sure you come, okay, Haruki? You don't have any reason to refuse it, right? It's just an honest celebration held at home, after all."
"Takeya…?"
I don't know who exactly came up with this idea… but I know that it probably wasn't Setsuna.
I don't know who planned such an event that would be so convenient for me to participate in and thus very difficult for me to refuse.
"I want to discuss plans about a vacation trip with you as well. Otherwise, you'd immediately immerse yourself in part-time jobs if I don't plan ahead."
"I can't wait for spring break. We won't have much time to have fun once we get into our fourth year, so let's make the most of the present and enjoy ourselves, shall we?"
"Spring break, huh…"
After my exams are over… After my life as a third-year student comes to an end…
Once winter is over…
Where do I go, and who should I convey my feelings to?
…Who will I end up hurting, and what will I end up destroying in the process?
"Takeya?"
As I was momentarily lost in my own thoughts while looking downward, I'd walked past Takeya before I knew it.
Rather, what specifically happened was that Takeya suddenly stopped in his tracks, and he's now dumbfoundedly staring in the direction of the main gate while standing still…
"What is it, Takeya? What's the matter with…"
The moment I follow Takeya's gaze… the same expression forms on my face.
That's not all. The same happens on the face of the person who's within our line of sight…

She stares at us with the same look of bewilderment, and after that, she looks around her as if she'd just been robbed of her composure, and finally, her expression changes to one that suggests she's about to cry.
Even from afar, I can detect her anxiousness, sorrow and confusion. And I can feel the same expression creeping onto my face as well.
Why is she here…?
"Koha…"
"Yo～! If it isn't Koharu-chan! Well, what's up? Did you come all the way here to meet me～?"
Having noticed her first, Takeya's demeanor changed just a moment before mine did.
Regardless of whether that's a good thing or a bad thing, he ended up covering up what would have been a fatal mistake on my part.
"Isn't it cold being out here in a place like this? What's wrong? I would have come to get you immediately if you'd just given me a call."
"Ah, ah, umm…"
It's true. If she'd just given me a call, I would have immediately…
And to think there were many far more appropriate methods that she could have opted for rather than appearing here in such a conspicuous place and having Takeya notice her.
"Still, it's been quite some time since we last met here, right? I still remember how you had this intense look when you were glaring at us back when we first met."
"T-This isn't what it looks like. Um… this isn't what it looks like!"
As she tries her hardest to respond to Takeya's words, her gaze is desperately appealing to me.
Her eyes are probably trying to convey the same thing her words are. They're trying to tell me that 'It's not like that' and 'I never had the intention to do this.'
It's just that the meaning behind her words is completely different from what she's actually saying…
"Don't you have some business with us?"
"Like I said, I don't have any specific reason to be here. It's just, umm, I ended up coming here before I realized it…"
Takeya included me in his list of choices before I knew it, but regardless of how skillful his attempt at probing her is, Koharu's just incapable of reading it right now.
"Were you waiting for someone else?"
"…I wasn't. I'm sorry."
"No, you don't have to apologize. In fact, we're happy to have run into you, even if only by coincidence."
After all, the person who can't understand the reason for her actions the most happens to be herself…
That's what I can sense from her.
"That's right, if you're not busy right now, how about you go out with us, Koharu-chan? We were just about to get dinner. We were planning to celebrate our exams being halfway finished."
"…No, I'm fine. I'm sorry. I really don't have a particular reason to be here…"
"I haven't agreed to anything, and you shouldn't count your chickens when we're only half done with our exams."
…I usually wouldn't have been able to resist forcing my sermon onto him after a line like that.
"It's alright if you aren't busy, isn't it? If you're not comfortable being the only girl with two guys, I could call Io to come with us, you know."
"Like I said, I never agreed to anything…"
"No… I'm going home."
"…Is that so? That's a shame. We could've enjoyed ourselves to our hearts' content given that we have the day off tomorrow…"
"Aren't the two of you still in the middle of exams? Isn't this not the best time for the two of you to enjoy yourselves to your hearts' content?"
"…You don't have to rub salt into the wound. Haruki said the exact same thing just earlier."
"That's right. You're not supposed to be free right now…"
And Koharu lowers her gaze, now at a loss for words.
It's as if she's been gravely wounded by the very words she just said…
"Goodbye. Best of luck to you two."
"That so? See you, then. We'll come visit your restaurant after exams are over."
"I'll be waiting. Well then…"
"Ah! I'm sorry, I totally forgot about that!"
"Eh…"
"Haruki?"
This is bad… I have to make things seem coherent.
"Sorry! This was completely my mistake. The truth is, I actually made an arrangement with her."
"Haruki…?"
Whether it's in response to Koharu's behavior, to the fact that she's here now, or to her current emotions.
"I-I'm not! I wasn't waiting for you, Senpai…!"
"…Koharu-chan?"
"I know that it's my fault that I'm so late, but you really don't have to look so mad…"
"S-Senpai…?"
…My brain, which should have been exhausted by the exam in the morning, regains its composure almost immediately.
"I promised you last week at work… to give you a tour of the campus."
I accept my current circumstances and internally readjust my priorities, and with it, I come up with the most suitable scenario.
"I told her that I showed Takahiro-kun around campus last month and she said she wanted to visit as well, so we made an arrangement…"
I was the one who Koharu was waiting for.
But that's only because her senior from both her part-time job and the university she's going to attend happens to be the same person.
…He also happens to be the boyfriend of her classmate's older sister…
We promised to meet each other at the main gate after school ended on Friday and left work uneventfully afterward.
And today so happens to be Friday…
Koharu had arrived on time as promised, whereas I've been hanging around the school grounds with Takeya, having forgotten this rather trivial promise I've made with my junior.
Of course, we couldn't even contact one another given that we've never even exchanged phone numbers before.
And after waiting for me for more than an hour, she then saw the person who made that promise brazenly walking out without feeling even slightly nervous…
Koharu got really mad as a result, and acted as if she never made that promise with me to begin with.
"So that's how things are. I'm truly sorry!"
"I know I'm a little late, but why don't I show you around right now? …I'll even treat you to dinner, though we'd be eating in the cafeteria."
"U-Umm…"
Koharu's gaze is wavering.
And Takeya's gaze… doesn't even have the slightest hint of suspicion.
Because the intense glint in his eyes suggests that he's gone past merely finding me suspicious and is now convinced that I'm lying.
"Let's go. …This is what's going on, Takeya, so I'm sorry."
"Haruki…"
But I can't afford to falter in that right now. I can only push forward and act as if what I'm saying is the truth.
"Come on, let's go."
"Senpai…"
"See you, Takeya. I'll call you later."
"Hey, Haruki… make sure you come to the party next week, okay?"
I couldn't bring myself to turn toward Takeya in response to his rather miserable tone when he said that, only lightly raising my hand in response.
I lightly push Koharu's back as we head back to where I just came from… into the university.
I'm turning my back on my friend. I can only concentrate on directly walking toward the darkness where I can't see what lies beyond.
I'm doing this because… I absolutely can't leave Koharu alone here right now.
I can only believe in that intuition.
"You can really be scary sometimes, Senpai…"
"How so?"
"Even though you're usually so honest to a fault, you hold nothing back when you lie."
"…You think so?"
"You know, there was that first time… back when we were looking for Ogiso-senpai together. You threatened the customers and the staff in the restaurant…"
"Something like that… did happen, yes."
That was the day when I accepted Koharu's dedication to meddle with my problems for the first time…
"You managed to spout out things one after the other without even thinking… and to a friend of all people. …Even though all of this was my fault."
"I really am terrible, aren't I…"
It's times like this where I realize the painful truth… I'm an absolutely preposterous liar.
I talk about wanting to be honest with the people that are important to me while also being able to deceive them without batting an eye.
"No, I'm the one who's terrible. …I'm sorry."
"…For what?"
"I'm sorry…!"
Goodness me…
"Even though I promised I would wait… I'm sorry!"
We're currently in an exam period, and it's evening at the moment…
"I said I would endure until your exams were over, Senpai… but I couldn't even keep that promise even though I made it myself…!"
But there's still quite a number of people walking in front of us, as usual.
"Before I knew it, I was already standing there… It really wasn't my intention at all."
"I understand…"
"No, you don't understand, Senpai. It's because I'm lying to you right now."
"Koharu…"
"I waited at a spot like that and I could've been noticed by anyone. Iizuka-senpai, Mizusawa-senpai… even Ogiso-senpai might've noticed me."
"It's not like I didn't realize that. I was fully aware of it, but I came nonetheless. …I've done something so terrible."
"That's not a lie."
"It is a lie… It's a cruel betrayal. And I've betrayed you of all people, Senpai…"
That's not a lie… it's just her inability to make a decision.
It's just that her desires overpowered her expectations of the consequences of her actions by the slightest margin.
"Hey, Koharu."
"Y-Yes?"
I can't say I can completely understand what's in Koharu's heart, though.
"Where would you like to go right now?"
"Senpai…"
"I don't mind making the lie come true by showing you around the campus and having dinner in the cafeteria as we promised. …Even going to a family restaurant is fine by me."
"Senpai…!"
"So don't cry. …At least, not while it's not just the two of us present."
Goodness me…
"…Uu, uuu, I'm… sorry… I'm so sorry."
We're currently in an exam period, and it's evening at the moment…
"Come on, you can come closer if you want."
But there's still quite a number of people walking in front of us, as usual.
"Ye…s… excuse me…"
Why am I patting the head of a girl who's wearing our high school's uniform in full view of the surrounding crowd…?
And all while I'm hugging her shoulder, at that.
"…Would you like to stay here until you've calmed down a little?"
"N-No… I'm fine now. Staying here any longer will cause you trouble, Senpai."
Despite having said that, she hasn't lifted her head off my shoulder…
"Then, where do you want to go? I'll take you anywhere you want."
"Really? You're alright with taking me anywhere?"
"Well, if it's close by."
"…It's close by. We should be able to walk there."
"I see… since you already have a place in mind, shall we go?"
"Umm… I'm sorry. I want to apologize to you first."
"Like I said, everything you've done up until now is…"
"It's not about that… I just lied to you, Senpai."
"…Is it far?"
"No, it's not that… it's about where we're going…"
As Koharu said that, she slowly lifted her head that was resting on my shoulder.
And then, to prevent anyone else from hearing it, she inches her mouth to my ear so close that I could feel her breath.
"…Your apartment."
"Whoa, it's so clean and neat, just as I thought it'd be!"
"Well, I do clean my room at least twice a week."
"Wow, I have to say this is quite the amount of produce you have here. I've heard that men who live alone have nothing but beer in their fridge."
"Where did you hear that…?"
"W-Whoa, you even properly clean your bathroom! And not just with water, you even use actual bathroom cleaners!"
"Well, I only do that about once a week, but… Koharu?"
"Ah, wow, wow! The night view's pretty here! Ah, it is cold here, though… and I can hear the noise of the air conditioner's outdoor unit…"
"Koharu!"
"…Calm down. And it's cold as you said, so close it, Koharu."
"…Okay."
…Though she said it's cold outside, her forehead is drenched with sweat.
"Don't just stand there. Sit down for now."
Why did she have to end up being so nervous just like I expected her to be…? If this keeps up, I'm going to get nervous too.
"Please… excuse me."
She just realized that she hasn't performed the usual etiquette that she'd normally never forget to do, which made her blush in embarrassment.
"Wait, that's…"
"Eh… ah, ahh!?"
…Things would have been alright if it ended at that, but she didn't notice the cushion I prepared in front of the table, and ended up sitting on my bedーa huge mistake.
Koharu flushed a bright red that reached her ears and lowered her gaze, making even me embarrassed this time.
"Um, umm… Senpai…"
"W-What is it?"
"What shall… we do?"
"W-What do you mean…"
We're acting like a middle-schooler couple…
I don't remember things transpiring this awkwardly during my first experience, though.
"I'm fine with… whatever you want to do, Senpai."
Wait, why am I even comparing what's happening right now to what happened during my first time…?
Am I hoping for the same thing that happened three years ago right now?
…Even so…
"…Shall we prepare dinner together? We haven't eaten anything, after all."
"Eh…"
Even so, things are different from the circumstances back then.
There's still a future that we can share between us.
And there's still a possibility that today will connect to tomorrow and extend into a future further beyond…
"For the time being, I do have all the usual ingredients I need to make curry. Do you know how to work with knives, Koharu?"
"…I don't."
"Ah, so you've never used them before, huh…? You seem like somebody who does though."
"No, I normally do use them, but I don't want to for today."
"Why?"
"Because if I'm focused on cooking, I can't look at you, Senpai."
"And I don't want that… because we don't have much time. I'm already wasting your precious time like this."
But Koharu has absolutely no intention of letting any unnecessary thoughts interfere with the short time we can spend together alone for the day.
"…We can talk while peeling the potatoes, can't we?"
"I can only concentrate on one thing. I'm sure I'll end up going silent if we do that."
I… can totally imagine that happening, actually. In her particular case, that is.
"That's why I… have to focus only on you, Senpai. Ah, just do whatever you want, I don't mind."
"And… what should I do?"
"Umm… you could study for your exams."
"And what will you do while I'm studying, Koharu?"
"I'll look at your face from the side the whole time."
"Ah, this is a better idea than I thought it'd be. I won't end up bothering you any further than I have by doing that, Senpai…"
"As if we could go with something like that!"
"Uh…"
How is any of this "doing what I want to do"…?
You've not been allowing me to do what I want to do at all.
As I thought, people who are used to directing others will inevitably come into conflict in situations like these…
"If you focus on me, Koharu, then I'll have to focus on you too. …If I don't, I'll be too bothered by it to do anything else."
"You will… focus on me too, Senpai?"
"Koharu…"
"Nhh…"
Since our eyes were focused on each other, it didn't take much time for the distance between us to disappear.
"Nn, nnh… nnh… hah… anh… nn."
Was Koharu the one who closed her eyes first, or was I the one who touched her lips first…?
"Hah, hahh… ah, nn, chu… hahh… nn, nnh… nhh… hah, ahh."
Was I the one who stuck my tongue in first, or was she the one who wrapped hers around mine first…?
"Nnnh… hah, hahh, hahh, haah… haah, haah… Senpai… Haruki-senpai…"
"Koharu…"
Every time Koharu speaks, the silver thread connecting our lips sways.
Her sweet breath reaches my face. Her wet eyes reflect my ravenous face.
"More… please do it more. I want it twice as long this time. And then, twice as long again…"
"Koharu…"
"Actually, this was more or less my goal… because I can't concentrate outside."
Knowing that she could only concentrate on only one thing at a time, she sought out a circumstance that would allow her to focus entirely on only one thing.
Koharu's thought process wasn't wrong, but…
"Before that, there's something I have to tell you."
"…What is it?"
"If we do this any longer, I won't be able to stop myself."
"…Is that so?"
Her eyes widen in surprise, but they show no hesitation.
We sit on top of the bed, with my hands on her shoulders. …In a position where I could push her down at any moment.
Koharu still focuses on my eyes.
"How about you… Koharu? What do you want me to do?"
"You're giving me the right to choose?"
"If you're not mentally prepared, then…"
"…If you let a girl choose, I think you need to reconsider your position as a man."
"Still, if you really don't feel like it, then…"
"I think it's fine to do whatever you want, Senpai. As for me… I won't regret it, you know?"
Still, being able to answer in such a logical manner shows how strong she is during critical moments.
"I… I'm sorry. Honestly, I'm still not sure."
Which is my weakness during this critical moment… Not logic, but emotions.
"You're thinking about Ogiso-senpai, aren't you…?"
"I'll always think about her. Even now, and going forward…"
"But I'm not worried about Setsuna right now."
"…? Then what is it?"
"I'm hesitating because I don't understand… I don't understand what I should do to put you at ease as best I can, Koharu."
"Should I get closer to you and embrace you, or should I keep this distance and just continue to look at you."
Or should I distance myself a bit more from her until both of our problems have been resolved…
"I don't have enough information to decide right now."
Because Koharu doesn't talk about it.
She doesn't tell me about just how much pain and suffering she's enduring, and how exactly I should help her.
Because much like today, she's only shown me that mysterious attitude of hers.
"Isn't there something you want to do… Senpai?"
"…There is."
"Don't you want my body? Well, it's true that my chest is small… and you won't feel anything embracing me…"
"I want it… Your body is cute, and I want to touch it in so many places."
"Then!"
"But what I want most right now is to make you feel at ease as best I can, Koharu."
"…You think I'm indecisive, don't you?"
"Then I… I want to make you even happier, Senpai."
"If you show me your smile, Koharu, I'll be happier."
"If you'll be happier, Senpai, then I'll show you my smile."
"Like I said, I want to do this for you, Koharu!"
"And I want to do this for you, Senpai!"
We exchange glances and suddenly start laughing.
But right now, Koharu doesn't close her eyes, and I don't draw my lips closer to hers.
"How long do you think we'll continue this?"
"Perhaps the last train will already have left by the time we snap out of it."
While being amazed at each other's stubbornness, we understand that we are just being considerate to each other, bringing us to an impasse.
"Then Senpai… let's aim for equality, okay?"
"How?"
"We say what we want on the count of three."
"Whether we want to do it or not."
"Are you serious…?"
"One, two…"
"Hey, wait a second! I still haven't made up my mind!"
"Then hurry up and decide. I've already made a clear decision."
"Ko…Koharu…"
Her gaze is resolute…
The way she was acting so intoxicated up until a while ago was extremely enticing, but it seems that she's returned to her usual class rep persona now.
Women… can really change like that in an instant, huh. They're really so…
"Are you ready now?"
"Wait! Give me a little more time to think!"
"…Just hurry it up please."
They're really so hard to understand…
"Then… here we go."
"Got it…"
The thirty seconds of thinking time Koharu gave me didn't even feel like three seconds.
…Well, there's a possibility she cut the time short.
"Alright… one, two…"
"Three!"

"I want to do it! I want you, Koharu!"

"………"
"Aah, ahahaha…"
"Ko…Koharu!?"
"Me too, Senpai! Senpai, Haruki-senpai!"
"Y-You tricked me!?"
"I'm happy… so happy. I really wanted to hear that from you loud and clear!"
"L-Liar… you liar!"
"Ahaha… ahahahaha… haha…"
We both fall over and hug on top of the bed. …We're positioned in a way that allows us to start at any moment.
And so we begin.
"Sorry."
"Ah… Mom? I'm sorry for calling you this late."
"It's about the party, seems like I won't be able to make it, sorry."
"I'm at the house of a senior from work. …She's Nakagawa-san, a junior college student."
"There aren't enough people in my workplace this weekend, so my coworkers begged me to work for all three consecutive days during the holiday."
"I ran into her on my way home from school… we started chatting and ended up losing track of the time…"
"It might be only a part-time job, but my position comes with a decent amount of responsibility. I just couldn't bring myself to refuse them."
"Then, she offered to treat me to dinner… I'm sorry. Have you already made dinner?"
"I'm really sorry. I will make it up to you soon. Also, I have something to tell you."
"Yeah, yeah… I see. So, I can have dinner here, right?"
"Alright then, give my regards to the others too."
"A-Ahh… yeah, right. Umm, I'll be back by…"
"Hyan!"
"I-It's nothing! It's just, there was a scary scene on the TV."
"Y-Yeah, let's see… umm…"
"…She said that I can stay here. Since it's late, and it's scary outside, so can I?"
"Nnhh! Ah, nnh… hah, ah, ahh… nnhh…"
"Se-Senpa… nhaaa… chu… nn… nnh, haa, ahh… hah, hahh, aahh…"
"Haah, haah, haah… anhh…"
"Wow… there's still some stuck in my bangs. I need to wash them again…"
"…Sorry."
"Ouch… the hot water stings my insides, it hurts."
"I sincerely apologize."
The door of the bathroom is very thin, so I can hear her complaining about my selfish lower half.
"Still, this kind of thing feels amazing somehow."
"What do you mean…?"
"A man going as far as to wash even my underwear while I casually take a bath."
"Well… that's because I stained them all."
"You're right. I've been stained by you. My heart, my body, not to mention my uniform and panties, all of it."
"…Are you angry?"
"No, not at all. You've already taken responsibility so far, so I can't possibly be angry at you."
"…I'll get it to dry by tomorrow somehow."
I've taken… responsibility? How exactly have I done that?
"In the end, I have no choice but to stay for the night. I'm glad I listened to you and called home beforehand."
"Haha…"
I can't really understand the true meaning behind her words, as usual, but her soothing, soft voice does put me at ease.
After we finished, I filled the bath with hot water in a hurry, took Koharu, who had still been staring at the ceiling in a daze, and set her down in it.
After I had confirmed that Koharu had turned on the shower, I gathered the clothes she took off, brought them to the bathroom, and washed them with hot water and detergent.
…While doing this, I finally realized that I was actually completely naked.
"Say, Senpai."
"Hm?"
"You're the type who will do housework even after you're married, right?"
"Aa-Ahh!?"
I spilled a bit on the floor…
"You should just stay away from lazy women, you know? You'll end up overworking yourself and collapsing with both your job and housework."
"W-W-W-What are you talking about!?"
"I'm just making small talk, you know? Are you misunderstanding something, Senpai?"
"No, I… I'd say I'm interpreting it in a perfectly normal way?"
…It's alright for me to misunderstand, now, right?
"Would you prefer dual income, Senpai? Or would you want your wife to stay at home?"
…I feel like I've been given a lot of difficult questions for a while during this supposed small talk.
"…If my wife earns a lot, there's always the option of being a house husband, you know?"
"I wonder if you'll ever bring yourself to abandon your work, Senpai."
"I won't know until I get a real job. I'm still a university student, after all."
"Sure, but when I think about how much effort you're putting into work right now, I just can't imagine you leisurely watching TV while waiting for your wife to come home."
"…You'll turn all the housewives in the world into your enemies like that, you reserve troop."
Of course, there's no way I can imagine something like that happening to me either.
"Senpai, you give me the image of a man who, if asked to choose between either family or work, would answer 'both' without hesitation."
I can't deny that.
"See? That's why I hope you won't die before me, Senpai… I'd really hate that, you know?"
Why would Koharu hate something like that…?
"I could say the same to you, Koharu."
…Who am I kidding? As if I could bring myself to say that.
"Ah, you're right… I'll have to take care as well."
After all, I absolutely wouldn't want Koharu to pass away before I do.

Even though it's no more than unreasonable, irrational feelings welling up inside me now, like a child breaking into tears upon being asked the question, "What would you do if Mommy died?" by their own mother…
"Aah～ this feels so good. I think I could fall asleep at this rate."
"You can sleep if you like. I'll make sure to take you to bed if that happens."
"Ahaha… I'll be in your care when that happens～!"
"Not a problem. Besides, Koharu, you're light as a feather."
"And Senpai, you're very heavy, you know?"
"…I'm terribly sorry for that."
"Ahaha… ahahahaha."
But I'm glad… I didn't make the wrong decision.
Because Koharu is laughing right now. She's relaxed and letting me see her smiling face right beside me.
With the way I am now, there's nothing else in the world that would make me more relieved…
Or at least that's how things should've been.
"Uu… uu… uaaaa…!"
"Koharu… Hey, Koharu?"
"Uuu… uaaaa… aaahhhh! Noooooooo!"
"Calm down! You're alright, you're in my room, remember?"
"S-Senpai… Senpai? Uu… uu… uu-uu-uugh… uuhaaa…"
"Waaaaaaaaaaa! Nooo, uu… uu…!"
No matter how tightly I embrace her… no matter how many times I kept telling her she's a good girl in order to soothe her…
"Why, why… uuuwaaaaa! Uu… uu, uu… uu-uu… uuaa-aa…!"
A single release of her explosive emotions violently overwhelmed Koharu.
Finally she whispered, "This is where I'm most comfortable"… and buried her face into my chest, taking many deep breaths.
Koharu, who's letting out a genuinely blissful sigh as I gently caress her disheveled hair.
Even as I embraced her tightly, even as I showed her my resolution, and even as I accepted her feelings…
Once a deep wound is made, it's just not something that will heal so easily…
"Thank you for letting me stay over."
And then, dawn breaks…
Koharu's eyes look somewhat swollen, but otherwise, she looks like her usual self.
Wearing the uniform that had just dried while holding her bag with both her hands, she swiftly bows her head.
"I'm sorry about last night… I ended up giving you a lot of trouble."
"Not at all…"
"I forgot to mention… I'm not good at sleeping in the dark at all."
That's a lie.
"Ever since I was little, I really couldn't handle dark places, so if the lights are off, I will become like that."
That's definitely a lie.
"…That's all there is to it."
It was such an obvious lie, yet Koharu still kept insisting that it was simply a fear of the dark.
…Just like how I did yesterday.
"You can take your time… today's the weekend, after all."
"I've got work."
"There's still more than two hours until they're open. You can get there in about fifteen minutes from here…"
"I still want to go back home to change into my casual clothes… What will Nakagawa-san think if I go in wearing a freshly washed school uniform?"
"Then, I'll walk you ho…"
"You can't. You're in the middle of exams, aren't you?"
"Koharu…"
"Jeez, you're spoiling me, Senpai… You should really stop treating me like that. I feel like I'll become weaker and weaker if you do."
Has she become weak, or was she never all that strong to begin with…?
I've always thought of her as nothing but a strong girl when I first got to know her. By the time she got involved with me, I'd also come to see her as a kind girl.
And ever since the moment she stood by my side, she's done nothing but cry and cry all the while.
"Do your best on your exams, Senpai."
"Yeah."
"I'll use my fingers to count down the days till we meet again, Senpai, and do my best from tomorrow."
"Well then…"
Koharu puts her sock-covered feet into her small leather shoes.
She lightly taps the floor with the tip of her shoe, and when she finishes putting her shoes on, she slowly turns her back against me and reaches for the doorknob.
"Koharu…"
"…Yes?"
Even when I called out to her, she didn't let go of the doorknob and replied without turning around.
"Do you not regret that… things have turned out this way?"
"I don't."
"Have you ever wished that you had never met me?"
"Never."
"Have you ever wished to go back to the time before winter when you still got along well with Yada-san…?"
"I never wished for that."
She responded to everything instantly.
I barely even managed to finish my last question before she expressed how she felt without hesitation.
…Since she has her back to me, her answers hit the door before reaching me.
"You're too pessimistic, Senpai."
That came from… a girl who couldn't stop crying last night for more than an hour.
"Now that I have tasted this kind of joyful pain which made me feel like my heart was about to burst, I can't go back to how I was before… nor do I want to."
"Koharu…"
"I'm so wonderfully in love with you right now that I wish everything else in the world would turn out as good as this, you know?"
"Why are you saying something so embarrassing…? It's really not like you, Koharu."
…There's no way I can say that. And I absolutely don't want to say it either.
"What I wished for came true, but as a result, it has become more difficult for your wish to be granted, though, Senpai."
"What I wished for… came true last night."
"Thank you… so very much…"
Perhaps it's because Koharu firmly believes that she's responsible for all this that she's not saying anything?
Perhaps it's because of love that she wants to shoulder everything herself, and yet, it's exactly because of this love that she doesn't want me to be burdened either.
And if that were really the case, it'd only be a clash of our egosーof wanting to do this for the other's sake.
Both of us are selfish and stubborn, but we think about each other more than anyone else…
More than anyone else…?
"Goodbye…"
"…Koharu!"
"Ah… nn, nn… nhuu…"
As I opened the door, Koharu was there… that much was obvious.
"Nn… nmuu…"
"Nnnh… chuu… haah… haah, haah…"
But I was so glad that I could catch her that I hugged her small body tightly and took her lips by force.
"Senpai, we're… outside…"
"See you later. …Be careful, okay?"
"Ah…"
Because I didn't like the way she left.
I just didn't want her to say the word "Goodbye," regardless of what it would mean.
"I'm… off?"
"Yeah."
"I'm off…"
"Take care."
"I'm off!"
"See you later, Koharu."
"Alright!"
When I embraced her, I noticed her uniform was slightly wet, but…
Even so, the smile that Koharu last showed me was so dazzling that it dispelled the chill of the cold winter morning.
